camps.name: Arrowhead Day Camp
camps.description_short: Traditional day camp in West Chester, running since 1956, for boys and girls ages 4 to 13. camps.swim_waterfront_notes: Each camper takes a swim test on day one and gets lessons in groups of 6 to 12 by ability across four heated pools, plus daily free swim; colored bands mark depth limits. The camp also has a man made fresh water lake for boating and fishing.
camps.notes: 2027 tuition: 8 weeks $6,545; 7 weeks $6,125; any 6 weeks $5,600; any 5 weeks $4,975; any 4 weeks $4,545; first or last 4 consecutive weeks $4,245. Horseback riding twice a week is extra ($350 to $450). These rates apply to deposits received before December 1, 2026; later deposits pay a higher Tier 2 rate that the page does not list. Tuition includes door to door transportation, lunch and snacks; families who drive (9:30 drop off, 3:00 pick up) get $100 a week off, and meeting at a bus stop takes $50 a week off. Extended day 7:30 to 5:30 at no extra cost. Sibling and referral discounts. Dates are tentative pending school snow days.

camps.name: Music Theatre Philly Weekly Summer Camps
camps.description_short: Weekly musical theater camps at Music Theatre Philly's Center City studios on Locust Street for ages 3 through rising 6th grade. Each week has a show theme; campers learn songs and choreography with professional teaching artists and perform a Friday showcase that is filmed for families.

fees.name: Before care
fees.note: 8 to 9 a.m.; $20 a day

fees.name: After care, grades 1 to 6
fees.note: 3 to 5:30 p.m. Monday to Thursday; $40 a day; none on Fridays

fees.name: After care, PreK to K
fees.note: Noon to 3 p.m.; $60 a day

camps.refund_policy_summary: Full refund less a $25 registration fee per class if cancelled more than two weeks before the session; 50% refund less the $25 within two weeks; no refund once the session starts.
camps.notes: Rising grades 1 to 6 run 9 a.m. to 3 p.m. at $575 a week, split into grades 1 to 3 and 4 to 6. PreK to rising kindergarten (ages 3 to 5, potty confident) run 9 a.m. to noon at $375 a week, with their own weekly themes on the same dates. 20% off with code EARLYBIRD27 before January 1, 2027; sibling and multi camp discounts. Campers pack a nut free lunch. The grades 1 to 6 page prints Week 12 as August 23 to 29; the PreK page and the Monday to Friday schedule give August 27, used here. Summer Stock for grades 4 to 12 runs at the Arts Bank and is listed separately.

camps.name: Penn Charter Day Camp
camps.description_short: Weekly day camp on Penn Charter's 47 acre East Falls campus for children 3 to 13 who are toilet trained. Campers have swim lessons and free swim, tennis, archery, art, music, dance, drama, sports and electives; families pack lunch.
camps.notes: 2026: June 15 to July 24, closed June 19 and July 3, 9 am to 3 pm. $550 a week, $495 for the two 4 day weeks; 25% deposit. Extended day: 8 to 9 am $50, 3 to 5 pm $125, both $150; the page does not say whether these are weekly. Bring lunch and a drink. Penn Charter also runs a Sports Camp (ages 6 to 13, same dates and prices), one week specialty camps and varsity sports camps on the same campus, with summer transportation new for 2026. 2027 details not posted yet. The page shows summerprograms@penncharter.com but its link goes to summercamps@penncharter.com, so no email is recorded.

camps.name: Summer at AIM
camps.description_short: Four week summer program at AIM Academy in Conshohocken for students in grades 1 to 12 from any school. AIM teachers give small group instruction in reading, writing, comprehension and math with interactive projects, full day or mornings only.
camps.refund_policy_summary: Full refund for withdrawal before May 1; after May 1 a full refund is not possible.
camps.special_needs_notes: Built on AIM's approach to language based learning differences, but no diagnosis is required. AIM says the program cannot serve cognitive impairment, needs on the autism spectrum, or emotional or behavioral conduct disorders. Non AIM students have a short virtual academic screening.

sessions.name: Summer at AIM, full day (9 am to 4 pm)
Summer at AIM, mornings only (9 am to 12:30 pm)

camps.notes: 2027: July 6 to July 30 (closed July 5). The page presents these as early bird rates: full day $3,800, mornings $2,800, before care $260, after care $260 for the program. 50% deposit before May 1, balance due May 1; no proration for missed days. No summer scholarships. Bring lunch and snacks. Van service from Center City was offered in past years through a private company; the campus is across from SEPTA's Miquon station.

camps.name: Summer Camp at Honey Hollow
camps.description_short: Nature day camp on Honey Hollow's 55 acre preserve of meadows, forests, ponds and streams near New Hope. A half day Nature Exploration Camp serves ages 4 to 6 and the Summer Adventure Camp serves ages 6 to 12, with a new theme each week mixing outdoor exploration, science, games and free time outside.
camps.refund_policy_summary: Full payment at registration. Cancel 30 or more days before camp for a full refund, 14 to 29 days for half; no refund within two weeks.
camps.notes: Session prices are the non-member full day Summer Adventure rate. Summer Adventure (6 to 12): full day 9 to 3, $395 non-members, $345 with family membership; half day 9 to 12, $240 or $210. Nature Exploration (4 to 6): half day 9 to 12, $240 or $210. No camp the weeks of June 29 and July 6.

camps.name: Summer Camp at The Waldorf School of Philadelphia
camps.description_short: Weekly day camp led by Waldorf teachers on the school's wooded Germantown campus for ages 3 to 14. Summergarten (ages 3 to 5) plays outdoors with water play and stories, Camp Wonder (grades 1 to 3) gardens, crafts and goes on a weekly outing, and Wonder Studios (grades 4 to 8) picks a studio such as woodwork, outdoor skills or sports each week.
camps.notes: 2027: nine weeks June 21 to August 20 (Week 3 is July 6 to 9), 8 am to 4 pm, early drop off and late pick up at no extra cost. Regular weekly prices: Summergarten and Camp Wonder $499, Wonder Studios $549. Early bird: $449 to $465 a week until January 31 and $475 to $495 until March 31, and up to 30% off for 3 or more weeks. Snacks and materials included; Wonder Studios has a weekly pool day and Friday trips with transportation. Registration opened November 20, 2026. Limited tuition assistance, first come first served. Grade is the one entered in fall 2027.
